articles.title: Bitcoin consolidates near $78,000 as investors await key US inflation, Fed cues
articles.description: Bitcoin traded near the $78,000 mark on Thursday as investors awaited key US inflation data and the Federal Reserves September 16 rate decision. The cryptocurrency remained range-bound amid macroeconomic uncertainty, while Ethereum and major altcoins also declined. Analysts said upcoming economic data and geopolitical tensions could determine the markets next move.
